## corpsespun minotaur (CR 5)

**XP** 1,600  
 NE Large undead  
 **Init** +0; **Senses** darkvision 60 ft.; Perception +9  

**Defense**

 **AC** 14, touch 9, flat-footed 14 (+5 natural, –1 size)  
 **hp** 60 (6d8+6 plus 6)  
 **Fort** +6; **Ref** +5; **Will** +5  
 **Defensive Abilities** natural cunning, channel resistance +2; **DR** 5/magic; **Immune** undead traits  

**Offense**

 **Speed** 30 ft.  
 **Melee** greataxe +11/+6 (3d6+7/x3), gore +5 (1d6+2) or slam +10 (1d8+7), gore +5 (1d6+2)  
 **Space** 10 ft.; **Reach** 10 ft.  
 **Special Attacks** poison (DC 14), powerful charge (gore +12, 2d6+7), spider spray (20-ft. cone, 3d6 swarm damage plus distraction and poison, Reflex DC 14 for half, usable every 1d4 rounds), spider transfer  

**Statistics**

 **Str** 21, **Dex** 10, Con—, **Int** 1, **Wis** 10, **Cha** 12  
 **Base Atk** +6; **CMB** +11 (+13 bull rush); **CMD** 21 (23 vs. bull rush)  
 **Feats** Great Fortitude, Improved Bull Rush, ToughnessB, [Weapon Focus (greataxe)](../../rules/feats/weapon-focus.md); [Power Attack](../../rules/feats/power-attack.md) (no feat needed)  
*House rules: Power Attack needs no feat; in their place: Weapon Focus (greataxe).*  
 **Skills** Intimidate +5, Perception +9, Stealth +1, Survival +8; **Racial Modifiers** +4 Perception, +4 Survival  
 **Gear** greataxe  

**Special Abilities**

 **Poison (Ex)** Swarm—injury; save Fort DC (10 + 1/2 HD + Cha); frequency 1/round for 4 rounds; effect 1d4 Str; cure 1 save.  

 **Spider Spray (Ex)** Every 1d4 rounds as a standard action, a Corpsespun Creature can spray a hail of spiders from its mouth in a 20-foot cone. Each creature in the area takes 3d6 points of swarm damage (DC 10 + 1/2 HD + Cha modifier Reflex save for half) and is distracted (DC 10 + 1/2 HD + Cha modifier Fortitude save negates). The spiders quickly spread across the opponent’s body in the same round they contact it and  
 automatically bite, delivering a highly debilitating poison. The spiders cause swarm damage and distraction each round for 1d4 rounds, at which point they fall off and die. The save DCs are Charisma-based.  

 **Spider Transfer (Ex)** Whenever a corpsespun successfully hits an opponent with a natural attack, or whenever the corpsespun is successfully hit with a natural attack or unarmed strike, a number of spiders are automatically transferred to the opponent. The spiders quickly spread and swarm over the opponent (as detailed in the spider spray ability). These spiders fall off and die after 1 round.  

**Ecology**

**Environment** temperate ruins or underground  
 **Organization** gang (2–5) or troupe (1 corpsespinner plus 6–11 corpsespun)  
 **Treasure** incidental
